final: WITH film_copies AS (SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) as copy_count FROM inventory GROUP BY film_id), film_with_rating AS (SELECT fc.film_id, f.rating, fc.copy_count FROM film_copies fc JOIN film f ON f.film_id = fc.film_id), rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(copy_count) as rating_avg FROM film_with_rating GROUP BY rating), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(copy_count) as overall_average FROM film_with_rating) SELECT fwr.film_id, fwr.rating, fwr.copy_count, fwr.copy_count - ra.rating_avg as diff_from_rating_avg, fwr.copy_count - oa.overall_average as diff_from_overall_avg FROM film_with_rating fwr JOIN rating_averages ra ON ra.rating = fwr.rating CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10
